reason: In store.js.es6:196-201, the new `_ids` branch maps every id through `_lookupSubType` and then runs `delete obj[k]` unconditionally. When no matching collection was side-loaded, `_lookupSubType` (157-187) returns undefined, so the id list is replaced by an array of undefined. The singular branch at 204-207 avoids this by deleting only when hydration succeeds. The `muted_category_ids` example is weak, because categories resolve from memory (163-164), but any other plain id list hits the bug.
